copyReadyMarkdown:
# PursuitDesk backend alpha evidence

Status: pending private repo execution

Files: 9 markdown proofs, 8 screenshots, 8 transcripts, 6 signoffs.

Rule: no live data, no secrets, no workbooks, no commercial exports.

No customer workbook, production secret, certificate, payment key, invoice, billing export, or commercial tracker value is approved for this PR. If any appears, stop, remove, rotate where needed, and write an incident note.
The first PR should link the primary issue and maintain a ledger for 10 planned issue links. Placeholder IDs are allowed only until real GitHub URLs exist.
Branch protection remains on hold until the first Actions run exposes exact workflow, job, and required status check names. Do not guess names.
Each owner lane records go, hold, no-go, or defer. A hold must name the missing proof and next owner before the PR leaves draft.
Closeout is complete only when passed, deferred, blocked, no-leak proof, rollback status, owner signoffs, and next owner are written.
